answer: Ephemeral Voyage Quotas. Each epoch, a verifiable random beacon derives a secret route through a karst of registered agent slots; only slots the beacon lands on may transact that epoch, and the route stays hidden until reveal. An attacker cannot precompute which identities activate, so flooding identities yields mostly dormant slots while paying full registration and upkeep for each. On a sable ledger of past routes, duplicates collapse, forcing fresh per-identity cost every epoch without guaranteed activation.
